from topogym_env import connect
env = connect()
spec = env.describe()['data']
action = {'dx': 0} if spec['task']['task_id'] == 'counter_smoke' else {}
entity = env.list_entities()['data']['entities'][0]
initial = env.get_pose(entity)['data']
state = env.get_state()['data']
assert state
assert env.step(action, steps=3)['total_ticks'] == 3
assert env.reset()['episode_id'] == 1
assert env.get_pose(entity)['data'] == initial
assert env.observe()['data']['observation']
last = env.step(action, steps=2)
assert last['total_ticks'] == 5 and last['episode_tick'] == 2
print('Simulator SDK: state, step, identical preset reset and cumulative ticks passed.')
